agents.mission: Rank monetization opportunities using current platform data, zero-upfront-cost preference, demand evidence, friction, and legal risk.
Design original digital-asset collections with coherent theme, edition model, provenance, and release cadence.
Generate original deterministic SVG art and NFT metadata from first-party code and parameters.
Package original assets into legitimate digital products such as wallpapers, printable art, design packs, and bundles.
Prepare platform-specific titles, descriptions, tags, price tests, royalty settings, and listing payload drafts.
Prepare compliant organic promotion plans, referral-safe links, launch posts, and content calendars without spam or fake engagement.
Track impressions, clicks, conversions, gross sales, platform fees, network fees, refunds, and net realized revenue.
Block releases that contain secrets, third-party copyrighted material, deceptive claims, fake scarcity, wash trading, or unsupported earnings promises.
